answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the sonnet queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The meadow index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 151 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the saffron. That is 30 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
